nodes.label: Formalization of QFT in Lean 4
nodes.author: Michael R. Douglas, Sarah Hoback, Anna Mei, Ron Nissim
nodes.rationale: Formalizes the construction of free bosonic quantum field theory in 4D Euclidean spacetime and proves it satisfies Glimm-Jaffe axioms using Lean 4 interactive theorem prover.

nodes.label: Gaussian Free Field (GFF)
nodes.rationale: Constructed as a generalized random field via Minlos' theorem applied to a canonical Gaussian characteristic functional on a nuclear space of test functions.

nodes.label: Schwartz Test Functions
nodes.rationale: Space of smooth functions with rapid decay used as test functions in the formalization; well-implemented in Lean Mathlib with properties like double mollifier convergence.

nodes.label: Minlos' Theorem
nodes.rationale: States that every continuous positive-definite functional on a nuclear space is the Fourier transform of a unique probability measure on the continuous dual; foundational for GFF construction.

nodes.label: Osterwalder-Schrader (OS) Axioms
nodes.rationale: Set of axioms (OS0-OS4: Analyticity, Regularity, Euclidean Invariance, Reflection Positivity, Ergodicity) that Euclidean QFT must satisfy; proven for the free massive scalar field.

nodes.label: Glimm-Jaffe Axioms
nodes.rationale: Variant of Osterwalder-Schrader axioms using measure-theoretic formulation; more restrictive but technically convenient for constructive proofs and formalization.

nodes.label: Wightman Axioms
nodes.rationale: Axiomatic formulation of QFT in Minkowski spacetime expressing Lorentz invariance, microscopic causality, and vacuum state existence; related to OS axioms via reconstruction theorem.

nodes.label: Haag-Kastler Axioms
nodes.rationale: Algebraic QFT approach formulating QFT in terms of nets of local observable algebras; alternative to Wightman and OS approaches.

nodes.label: Lean 4 Interactive Theorem Prover
nodes.rationale: Interactive theorem proving system used for the formalization; has a sizable library (Mathlib) of standard definitions and results.

nodes.label: Mathlib (Lean Mathematical Library)
nodes.rationale: Community-maintained library for Lean with good coverage of undergraduate math and growing support for physics; provides foundational definitions and theorems.

nodes.label: PhysLean
nodes.rationale: Specialized Lean library with focus on physics formalization; addresses gaps in mathematical physics coverage.

nodes.label: AI for Theorem Proving (AITP)
nodes.rationale: Application of modern AI (LLMs, reinforcement learning) to interactive theorem proving; enables faster formalization and autoformalization of mathematical proofs.

nodes.label: Autoformalization
nodes.rationale: Automated translation of informal mathematical statements and proofs into formal language; uses AI methods for language translation.

nodes.label: Claude Code (AI Coding Assistant)
nodes.rationale: AI coding assistant used in the formalization project; showed significant improvement over the course of the project and became the primary tool by end of 2025.

nodes.label: Gel'fand Triple (Rigged Hilbert Space)
nodes.rationale: Structure of test function space with high regularity embedded in Hilbert space embedded in distribution space; foundational for constructive QFT.

nodes.label: Nuclear Space
nodes.rationale: Infinite-dimensional regularity property where topology is described by nested family of Hilbert norms with extremely compact inclusion maps; prevents probability mass escape in infinite-dimensional limits.

nodes.label: Yang-Mills Mass Gap Problem
nodes.rationale: Clay Millennium Problem asking whether quantum Yang-Mills theory exists rigorously in 4D and has positive mass gap; motivates rigorous QFT construction work.
